question: Should ip-proxy get records for Rayobyte residential (pay as you go, per GB) and Proxy-Cheap static residential IPv4 (per IP per month)?
why: debrid/rayobyte and debrid/proxy-cheap have no ip-proxy counterpart to relate to (entity search finds none), so they are kept as they are; a discover unit in ip-proxy would add the records and a later run could relate them
